properties.evidence_basis: Pre-pandemic Los Angeles–San Diego service level
properties.route_notes: Official source identifies 13 daily round trips as the pre-pandemic level.
June 2021 added 3 round trips to the then-current 4, confirming the prior level of 4.
Three round trips were added in June 2021, taking the route from 4 to 7.
4 + 3 = 7 daily round trips between Los Angeles and San Diego.

properties.evidence_basis: One full-corridor round trip added October 25, 2021
properties.route_notes: 7 + 1 = 8 daily round trips on the Los Angeles–San Diego trunk.

properties.evidence_basis: Published October 2022 timetable shows 10 trunk round trips
properties.route_notes: Used as the representative late-2022 service level; verify if the checkpoint must be exactly August 1.
10 daily round trips used for the Los Angeles–San Diego trunk.
No official evidence found of a trunk increase before 2025.

Current service was 3 RT below the 13-RT pre-pandemic level
Before 11th and 12th round trips were implemented
13 trunk RT in service; northern extensions increased separately
properties.route_notes: Future checkpoint; Los Angeles–San Diego total remains 13 while Goleta/SLO extensions increase.
